events.evidence: Saudi forces intercept three ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, by the Houthis
The Finnish defence ministry imposes temporary airspace and maritime restrictions after a drone struck a Russian cargo vessel in international waters of the Gulf of Finland, causing a fire
The Japanese trade ministry announces that Saudi Arabia agreed to triple the volume of crude oil stored in Japan to 24 million barrels

label.note: Houthi missile interception and Gulf airspace restrictions keep geopolitical risk elevated; Japan-Saudi crude stockpiling supports energy security.
